title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode1 Opening

rows.Line: I had some childhood friends I was really close with.

Our personalities were worlds apart,
but we always had a lot of fun together.
   The four of us got along really well.

That's why everyone readily agreed
  to my suggestion to form a band.

The starlit sky we saw on the way back from our
         first practice session was so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Phew! I've never done band stuff before, but playing together like that was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I guess it was quite rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: I agree. It was exhausting, but also a lot of fun, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, everyone... I just wanted to say thank you.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for going along with my sudden suggestion to form a band and play some Miku songs...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Also... If you don't mind, can we do this again?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Of course we should do this again!
We'll practice again tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, and beyond!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh... Was that a shooting star just now?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
What? Where?
Hey, let's go over to the jungle gym! Maybe we can see some more!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
It's so pretty!
Oh yeah, I think I saw something about it on TV this morning.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Really?
Does that mean we can see more if we wait here for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: A meteor shower... That must look amazing.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Just making a wish that we could stay like this forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Playing together, talking about stuff,
watching shooting stars on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep doing all that together forever!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: You know what... I have some binoculars and a star chart at home. Let me go get them so we can stargaze together!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Okay, so let's all go and drop off our instruments at home, then we'll meet back here again after that!
I thought we'd always be friends.
I thought we'd be together forever, but...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: So the object of this sentence...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hm? Is that Honami in the courtyard?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She's holding a sketchbook...
Her next class is probably art, then.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that your bass guitar? You're heading for practice, then?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look, I have to go now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I didn't manage to talk with her yet again...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(When did I start becoming so awkward around
Honami and Shiho? And Saki is...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Is this how it's all going to end? We'll just graduate and
split up without ever speaking to each other again?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku's amazing... She's always so free and versatile.
She can do anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My guitar case is so dusty...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I guess I won't ever be playing it again...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(We promised each other we'd form a band and be
together forever, but now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What was that flash of light just now...
Did it come from my phone?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
A classroom? But I was literally standing in my room
just a moment ago...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's my name.
Nice to meet you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This can't be real...
And how do you know my name?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Because this SEKAI is a place that was born from the
feelings of you and your friends, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
L-Luka's here too?! I can't even...
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Sorry to surprise you like this,
but there's nothing to be afraid of. We're here to help you and your friends.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll help you find your true feelings in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Once you do, your feelings will
give birth to songs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's why we are here. We want you... no, you and
your friends, to find your true feelings again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't tell me you've forgotten who your friends are?

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Playing together, talking about stuff,
watching shooting stars on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I wish we could keep doing all that together forever!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look, I have to go now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It will all be okay, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of you still feel the same way. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So you'll see each other again, right here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Miku and I will be waiting for you here too, so come
with your friends next time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are you trying to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Feels like I had the strangest dream...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I must've been asleep for a while.
It's already dark outside.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The stars are so clear tonight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hmm?
Wow. They're really bright tonight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I...haven't looked up at the stars in a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm all set for tomorrow with my new lip balm,
featuring this season's latest color!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Can't wait to go back to school again after so long! Ichi and the others will be sooo surprised! Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The stars are really out in full force tonight!
Whoa! Was that a shooting star?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'll never forget how beautiful the sky looked back when
we saw that meteor shower...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Another shooting star!
Well, might as well make a wish!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I wish that the four of us will be able to see a beautiful
meteor shower together again...
